title: Scene Breakdown Visual-Semantic Authoring Output V1
description: Step 1 external authoring output. Defines locked Visual-Semantic Scene/Beat boundaries and current Beat state only; each Beat may be a complete proposition or a distinct source-owned visual facet inside a larger proposition. Final visual directing is authored separately in Step 2.

artifact_id.description: Reserved Scene Plan Artifact ID copied exactly from the generated prompt.

script_text.description: Exact consecutive source narration owned by this Beat.

meaning_now.description: Current meaning/visual anchor justified by narration heard through this Beat, using current text plus already-established prior context but never later source.

visible_state_now.description: Concrete current still/state justified now by narration already heard. It may inherit established prior context; future narration is excluded.

delta_now.description: Material visual-anchor change versus the previous Beat. It may rely on already-established prior context; a new proposition or grammatically complete sentence is not required.

continuity_with_previous.description: Locked continuity/reset authority. First Beat of every scene and genuine developmental resets use new_setup.
